mechanism: A distributed coordination protocol where an agent broadcasts a query to locate external entities matching a {{criteria}}. Uses {{check}} to filter responses. Unlike {{search}}, which scans internal memory, Discover requires another party to answer.
invariants: A Discover states when it stops waiting; responses arrive as asynchronous {{signal}}s with no completion of their own.
Responses pass {{check}} against the {{criteria}} before counting as matches.
failure_modes: Silence read as absence: the window closed with no match, which licenses only that nothing answered.
Response flood: a broad {{criteria}} returns more than the caller can filter; the stop condition bounds time, not volume.
